correctness.rationale: The Weyl-projector orbit diagonalization gives singular values p|A(a,b)|. For nonzero norm t=Q(a), the intersection count is 1+chi(t(4-t)), and anisotropic zero-norm nonzero shifts have none. A sum of at most two odd-order roots cannot vanish, while the zero-shift sum of |S|=p-chi(-1) roots cannot vanish by cyclotomic irreducibility. Counting norm values gives support size 1+(p-chi(-1))^2/2. The two-point-shift frequency grid 2|cos(pi j/p)| dominates Theta(p^4) nonzero singular values, yielding the stated arcsine weak limit. Correct for odd prime fields, all complex matrices; neither zero-shift character sums nor nonlinear phase retrieval are fully classified.
